## Type of change
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `!`: breaking change (existing commands, options or `bmde.toml` files stop working as before)
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `test` / `build` / `ci` / `chore`

## Checklist
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass locally.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for the change.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`docs/`, README) if the behavior changed.
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org).
